entities.name: Tetzimoc
entities.description: Elder dinosaur of Ixalan covered in launchable quills, a manifestation of black mana and the hunger of death.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: Plane where the elder dinosaurs live.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: Golden city whose long hibernation held the elder dinosaurs in stasis.

entities.name: Elder Dinosaurs
entities.description: Enormous monsters each embodying one aspect of the land's magic.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Summoned the elder dinosaurs to battle the Phyrexians.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which the dinosaurs were summoned.

events.summary: The opening of the golden city reveals the elder dinosaurs, held in stasis during Orazca's hibernation.
events.quote: The opening of the golden city revealed the enormous elder dinosaurs

events.summary: Huatli summons Tetzimoc and the other Elder Dinosaurs to battle the Phyrexian intruders.
events.quote: Tetzimoc and the other Elder Dinosaurs were summoned by Huatli to battle the intruders.

relations.note: Summoned by Huatli to battle the intruders.
